mcfd_compat.ui.field.supported_crops: Supported Farmer's Delight crops: cabbage, tomatoes, onions, rice, and normal red/brown mushrooms.
mcfd_compat.ui.field.rich_soil_delivery: Put Rich Soil directly into the farmer's inventory. One block is consumed per converted field cell. Automatic requests can be enabled in the server config.
mcfd_compat.ui.field.rice: Rice: prepare one-block-deep source water above dirt inside the field. The farmer neither creates nor removes water, plants rice into it, and harvests mature panicles while preserving the lower stalk. A 1 panicle → 1 rice recipe is available to the farmer.
mcfd_compat.ui.field.mushroom: Mushrooms: select a normal red or brown mushroom. Each cell's ground is replaced with Rich Soil from the farmer's inventory, then the mushroom becomes a colony. Rich Soil Farmland is not suitable here.
mcfd_compat.ui.field.normal_crop: This crop grows on normal Farmland or Rich Soil Farmland. Put Rich Soil in the farmer's inventory to upgrade cells; tomato ropes are not required.
